name: Biscoff Cookie Butter on Ritz Crackers
whyItWorks: Smooth Biscoff spread has the thick, rich mouthfeel of peanut butter with a spiced cinnamon-graham flavor and zero nut fragments. Ritz crackers turn to soft paste almost instantly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread smooth Biscoff (never crunchy) between two Ritz crackers for quick, high-calorie energy.
